description: **A `preconnect` no longer fails the deploy's outbound-link check.** A `rel="preconnect"` or `rel="dns-prefetch"` element names an origin for the browser to warm up, not a page anyone opens -- and a bare origin like `fonts.googleapis.com` genuinely answers 404, so every page carrying one turned the check red. Origin-only hints are now skipped; `preload`, `prefetch` and every real reference are still checked, including a link to the same origin the hint names.
